fullContentHtml:
Download App Get Started for Free

The Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board (MPESB) has announced the MP ITI Training Officer (TO) Result 2026 on 24th July 2026 on the official website esb.mp.gov.in. Those candidates who have taken part in the recruitment examination can now verify their scores and merit position through their user account. This result is available in PDF format with the list of selected candidates for the next phase of the recruitment process. Candidates are advised to download the MP ITI TO result PDF and verify all details listed in the score card. This examination was held by the Madhya Pradesh government to select suitable candidates for filling up the Training Officer 1120 vacancies available in ITIs under various trades.

MP ITI TO Result 2026 Out

The Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board has announced the MP ITI TO Result 2026 for the candidates who appeared in the written examination. It contains details like the candidate’s information, roll number, qualifying status, and merit ranking. Candidates should keep the registration details handy while checking the result online.

MP ITI TO Result 2026 Download Link Active

The MP ITI TO Result 2026 Direct Link has been activated on the official website. Candidates are required to log in to the result portal using their credentials to view their qualifying status. We recommend you download and save a copy of the output for your records to use for verifying documents and scheduling appointments.

How to Download MP ITI TO Result 2026?

MP ITI TO Result 2026 is now available online on the official website of MPESB. Just follow the steps mentioned below to get the result with no difficulty.

  1. Go to the official website of MPESB.
  2. Click on link MP ITI Training Officer Result 2026.
  3. Enter Application Number and Date of Birth
  4. Submit the details.
  5. The screen will display the result.
  6. Download and print the result for reference.

What Details are Mentioned on MP ITI TO Result 2026?

After downloading the result, the candidates should check all the detail printed on the scorecard. Any discrepancy should be reported to the concerned authority immediately to avoid problems during the later process of recruitment. The MP ITI TO Result typically contains the following information:

  • Candidate’s Name
  • Roll Number
  • Registration Number
  • Category
  • Date of Birth
  • Examination Name
  • Marks Obtained
  • Qualifying Status
  • Merit Position
  • Instructions for Further Process

MP ITI TO Merit List 2026

The MP ITI TO Merit List 2026 is along with or after the declaration of result. The merit list will consist of names and roll numbers of candidates who have secured qualifying marks and are selected for the next level of recruitment. Merit list is prepared on basis of performance in written examination and applicable reservation policies.

MP ITI TO Cut Off 2026 (Expected)

The MPESB will release the official MP ITI Training Officer Cut Off 2026 after the declaration of the result. With the huge number of applicants and 1,120 vacancies announced for the recruitment drive, the cut-off is expected to be low.

Category Expected Cut Off (Out of 100)
General (UR) 72 – 78
EWS 68 – 74
OBC 66 – 72
SC 58 – 65
ST 52 – 60

What Factors Affecting MP ITI TO Cut Off 2026?

The cutoff for MP ITI Training Officer is determined by various factors that candidates should also be aware of. This will help them predict the cutoff and their estimated rank.

  • Vacancies
  • Difficulty level of exam
  • Total number of appeared candidates
  • Category-wise reservation
  • Previous year cut-off

MP ITI TO Document Verification Process 2026

The candidates who will qualify in the MP ITI Training Officer Result 2026 will be called for the document verification round. In this process, the Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board (MPESB) checks the eligibility, educational qualification, category certificate and other supporting documents of the candidate. Only those candidates whose documents are found valid and authentic will be considered for final appointment as Training Officers.

Documents Required for MP ITI TO Document Verification 2026

  • MP ITI TO Result 2026 Printout
  • Admit Card of the Examination
  • Application Form Printout
  • Class 10th and 12th Mark Sheets and Certificates
  • ITI Certificate/Diploma/Degree Certificate (as applicable)
  • Trade Qualification Certificates
  • Valid Photo Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, etc.)
  • Category Certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS), if applicable
  • Domicile Certificate
  • Disability Certificate (for PwD candidates)
  • No Objection Certificate (for employed candidates)
  • Recent Passport-Size Photographs

Shortlisted candidates in the MP ITI TO Result 2026 will be called for next stage of selection process. Before preparing the final selection list, the authorities will verify the educational qualifications, category certificates, identity documents and other required records.

MP ITI TO Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. When did MP ITI TO Result 2026 Released?

MP ITI TO Result 2026 has been released by the Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board on 24th July.

Q2. How to Check MP ITI TO Result 2026?

The candidates can check the result by visiting the official website of MPESB and entering the login credentials.

Q3. What details are required to download MP ITI TO Result 2026?

Candidates can generally access the result using their Application Number and Date of Birth.

Q4. Will MPESB declare the MP ITI TO Merit List 2026?

Yes, the merit list is released with or after the declaration of the result.

Q5. What are the next steps after the announcement of MP ITI TO Result 2026?

The shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification and other recruitment formalities as per MPESB.
